Every run prints all three numbers the claim compares: the RT_1/DGQ_1 mixed saddle point, the same mixed form with Q2/Q1, and a genuine Taylor-Hood Q2/Q1 STOKES solve, all for the same manufactured, exactly divergence-free velocity. Only the space under test drives the verdict. Mutation control: T2_MUTATE=1 makes the probe run the CORRECT variant, and the fixture then fails its own expectations.
